texts: The proposed POS solution must minimally meet the capabilities of critical functions and features that exist in the existing POS frontend and backend solution.
The POS solution must support Cashier and Self-Checkout POS UI customized to tenant requirements including boarding pass scanning.
The system should support offline mode and synchronize transactions when connectivity resumes.
The POS must support duty-free liquor allowance checks and GST toggling for traveler and non-traveler transactions.
The system shall integrate with Changi Rewards loyalty system for points earning and voucher redemption.
The POS solution shall integrate with CAG appointed digital payment providers such as ChangiPay.
The POS must support configurable restrictions on sale of age-restricted and regulated products.
The system shall automatically apply promotions and campaigns configured by tenants or CAG.
The POS frontend shall allow sales and refund transactions to be completed quickly to support retail operations.
The system shall log and audit all POS user activities including sales, refunds, voids, and logins.
